label: Rule editor: external checks
description: Extra checks of the YARA editor, next to Rulezet's own validation (which alone decides whether a rule can be saved): yarax = YARA-X diagnostics and formatter, cccs = CCCS YARA metadata standard, yaraqa = yaraQA logic / performance advice, duplicates = YARA rules of this Rulezet with the same strings and condition (or very close). true = offered in the editor (Check button and the 'External checks' step of Create, never blocking). Sigma (Sigma editor): sigma_siem = the rule converted (SIEM: Splunk, Elastic, Sentinel… where a SOC searches its logs) by the pySigma backends of sigma_siem_targets (splunk, splunk_spl2, lucene, esql, eql, elastalert, kusto, loki, secops, sumologic_cse), sigma_schemas = which fields each SIEM data model knows (Splunk CIM, Elastic ECS, Defender XDR, Sentinel ASIM, Azure Monitor), sigma_duplicates = Sigma rules of this Rulezet with the same / a very close detection, sigma_cost = what makes the search slow or noisy (efficiency score), sigma_pysigma = pySigma's medium / low advice, sigma_sigmahq = SigmaHQ repository conventions, sigma_sigmalint = sigmalint findings and quality score, sigma_rsigma = rsigma lint (needs the rsigma binary on the server; sigma_rsigma_path to point at it, else the PATH / ~/.cargo/bin).
